correctness.rationale: Derive exact cusp area by integration of min(width,2 sinh(s)y)/y^2, add hyperbolic Fermi strip L0 sinh(s) with O_P(s^2) endpoint overlaps, express L0+2 sum log h_i as the Möbius chord-product invariant. Ptolemy gives the sharp quadrilateral bound, and a Jacobian-exact two-coordinate integral gives the full ideal triangle CDF and endpoint exponent. Direct quadrature and independent low-discrepancy sampling corroborate but do not prove the derivations.

value.rationale: Natural random point clearance from geodesic sides of finite-area, infinite-perimeter polygons has a logarithmically divergent analog of the finite-body Steiner tube law. The finite correction encodes genuine hyperbolic shape, with a sharp regular-quadrilateral extremizer and a full exact ideal-triangle distribution. This is an all-n geometric classification of boundary-layer coefficients, not an arbitrary special-case numerical invariant.
